title: On the Generalized Dirichlet Divisor Problem
content: Using more advanced results on the growth exponent for Riemann zeta--function and accurate numerical estimations, we obtain better upper bounds for $\alpha_k$ ($9 \leqslant k \leqslant 20$) on the generalized Dirichlet divisor problem. This gives a minor improvement upon the recent result of Trudgian and Yang.
